errors.badNumber: Enter a valid mobile number, or include the country code.
errors.otpMismatch: That code didn’t match. Check it and try again.
errors.nameRequired: Add your name so we know whose reply this is.

identity.title: Is this you?
identity.intro: Your number is how we find your reply again — no passwords, no account to make.
identity.countryCodeHint: Outside India? Add your country code, like +44.
identity.codeIntro: We sent a six-digit code to {phone}. It keeps your reply yours — and lets you come back and change it.

days.title: Which days?
days.intro: Tell us where to save you a seat. Nothing is compulsory — come to what you can.

party.title: Who’s with you?
party.intro: Add everyone travelling under your invitation.
party.footnote: Party of {count}. You can change this until {date}.

table.title: At the table
table.intro: {count, plural, =1 {Meals across the evening. Pick what suits your party — the details go below.} other {Meals across all # events. Pick what suits your party — the details go below.}}
table.restrictionsHint: Vegan, allergies — anything the kitchen should know

travel.title: Getting there
travel.intro: So we know when you land and can send a car. Skip anything you haven’t booked yet.

done.bodyAccepted: Your reply is saved. We’ll nudge you the week before with pickup times and dress codes.
done.bodyDeclined: {partnerA} and {partnerB} will know. If anything changes, come back and say so — nothing is final until {date}.

share.title: Share with your family
share.body: Anyone in your party can scan this to see the days, the dress codes and your reply — without sending a second RSVP.
share.qrAlt: QR code opening the {partnerA} and {partnerB} invitation

shared.missingBody: This code doesn’t match an invitation. Ask whoever shared it to send it again — or open your own invite and reply there.
shared.repliedByHost: {name} has already replied for {count, plural, =1 {you} other {your party}}.
shared.repliedAnonymous: Your party’s reply is already in.
shared.nothingToFill: There’s nothing for you to fill in — this page is just so you have the details.
shared.replyingFor: Replying for {names}{extra, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}}.
shared.askHost: Travelling separately, or need your own seat counted? Ask {name} to add you to the reply.
shared.askWhoeverShared: Travelling separately, or need your own seat counted? Ask whoever shared this to add you to the reply.
